**Implementation note:** Contrarian weights without risk neutralization.

## Description

Buys recent losers and sells recent winners over a short horizon after stripping out market, sector and liquidity exposures.

## Where it may fit

Short-horizon overreaction in liquid stocks; deteriorates when reversals are overwhelmed by informed momentum or high costs.

## Vehicles

Equity market-neutral and statistical-arbitrage funds.

## Required data

Point-in-time stock returns, market/sector factors, intraday/daily liquidity, borrow availability and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Closely related to existing short-term reversal; kept distinct here because it explicitly neutralizes risk factors and models short-horizon cross-sectional trades.
